scope_summary: Spatial dependence, graph construction, and validation units were assessed.

findings.title: Random spot splits may leak spatial neighborhood information
findings.claim: Held-out spots constitute an independent test set.

evidence.excerpt: Spots were randomly assigned to training and testing sets.
evidence.note: The split is defined at spot rather than patient or section level.

findings.rationale: Adjacent spots from the same section can share local biology, morphology, and graph context across folds.
findings.impact: The reported AUROC may overestimate transfer to unseen tissue sections or patients.
findings.recommendation: Report leave-section-out and leave-patient-out validation, with a spatially blocked sensitivity analysis.

limitations: This result was created from a fictional teaching example and is not a review of a real manuscript.
